    requires |x| > 0 // The input list must be non-empty
    ensures result == SeqSort(SeqFilter(x, HasNoEvenDigits)) // The result is a sorted sequence of numbers without even digits

method HasNoEvenDigits(n: int) returns (res: bool)
    ensures res == (forall d :: (d in Digits(n) ==> d % 2 != 0)) // A number has no even digits if all its digits are odd

method Digits(n: int) returns (ds: set<int>)
    requires n >= 0
    ensures ds == {d | d in {0..9} && n / 10^i % 10 == d && i >= 0} // The set of digits of n
```
